entries.what_happened: One manuscript, 'The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six' (OpenAI, dated 25 September 2026), claims that every smooth connected complex projective Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous (Theorem thm:main, proved in sections/07-conclusion.tex). The route: if the Picard number is at least 2, Kanemitsu's theorem for ρ > n−5 applies. If ρ = 1, the minimal-rational-curve analysis leaves P^6, Q^6, pseudoindex 4 and pseudoindex 5; P^6 and Q^6 are homogeneous. Pseudoindex 4 is settled by an intersection-theoretic argument that rules out Kanemitsu's factorization case (a quadric-bundle contradiction). Pseudoindex 5 is the new step: for a general evaluation fibre F (a threefold) with polarization L, the paper derives u = c1(T_F)·L²/L³ satisfying 32−20u+3u² = 0, using characteristic-number identities and a finite linear-algebra calculation. The sectional-genus formula then forces u = 8/3 and L³ = 3, the variety of minimal rational tangents is the Segre P^1×P^2 in P^5, and Mok's recognition theorem gives Gr(2,5). The same manuscript also proves a compact Kähler corollary (cor:nef-tangent-uniformization): a connected compact Kähler X with analytically nef tangent bundle and dim X − q̃(X) ≤ 6 has ordinary universal cover F×C^q̃(X) with F rational homogeneous. It also states a positive Kähler–Einstein metric for Fano manifolds of dimension at most six with nef tangent bundle (cor:positive-ke). Against the candidates in problem_asks: the manuscript never mentions Hartshorne. The only candidate it bears on is (D), the ample-tangent-bundle conjecture (a smooth projective variety with ample tangent bundle is P^n). The introduction cites Mori 1979 for that ample case and calls the nef question 'natural' from it; it does not restate, prove or extend (D) as such. It makes no claim about (A), (B), (C), (E), (F) or (G).
entries.delivers: For candidate (D), only the dimension-six special case of the nef question: the theorem gives rational homogeneity for Fano sixfolds with nef tangent bundle. An ample tangent bundle is nef, so a Fano sixfold with ample tangent bundle falls under the theorem; the text does not draw this consequence, does not show that ampleness of T_X forces the Fano property, and does not identify the homogeneous conclusion with P^6 in the ample case. The manuscript does not say it settles Hartshorne's conjectures or any of the candidates, and its own framing is the Campana–Peternell conjecture, which it states as: every smooth complex Fano variety with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous. It proves that statement for dimension six only, with the Picard-number-one reduction and the pseudoindex-5 Grassmannian identification as the substantive content. For the Kähler corollary, the claim is the universal-cover splitting F×C^q̃ for dim X − q̃(X) ≤ 6 only.
entries.remains: If the claim holds, the Campana–Peternell conjecture remains open in dimensions seven and above, and the compact Kähler uniformization remains open when dim X − q̃(X) ≥ 7. For candidate (D), the text adds nothing beyond the dimension-six nef case and draws no consequence for the ample case in other dimensions. Candidates (A), (B), (C), (E), (F) and (G) are untouched.
entries.direction: proves a case: the Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six (Fano, nef tangent bundle); for candidate (D) only its dimension-six special case
entries.conditional_on: No hypothesis is assumed. The proof uses published results as black boxes: Kanemitsu 2016 Theorem 0.2 (ρ > n−5); Kanemitsu 2017 (minimal-family proposition, Theorem 3.3, Proposition 4.1, Remarks 2.3 and 4.2) for pseudoindex four and the fibre list; Dedieu–Höring 2017 Theorem 1.3 (pseudoindex at least 6); Mok 2008 Theorem 15 and Hwang–Mok 1999 Propositions 1.2.1–1.2.2 (minimal rational tangents); Kebekus 2002 Theorems 3.3–3.4; Mok's recognition theorem (Mok2008Recognition); and Eisenbud–Green–Hulek–Popescu 2006 Theorem 0.1 (varieties of minimal degree). The pseudoindex-five numerical identity 32−20u+3u² = 0 rests on a finite calculation that the text says is verified by a program, verification/verify.py. That file lies outside build/ and was not read here. The Kähler corollary also depends on Demailly–Peternell–Schneider 1994 (Propositions 3.4 and 3.9, Theorem 3.14), Claudon–Höring–Kollár 2013 Theorem 4.4, Fischer–Grauert 1965, Poczobut 2025 Theorem 1.1, and Bien–Brion 1996.
entries.doubts: (1) The pseudoindex-five identity is established by modular rank computations (mod 10007) and an exact check of six rational columns (sections/05-arithmetic.tex). The text says the certifying program is run as verification/verify.py (sections/08-certificate.tex). The reading here relies on that program, which was not read. (2) The Kähler corollary asserts, in one sentence without its own citation, that every positive-dimensional Albanese fibre is a smooth projective Fano manifold with nef tangent bundle (sections/07-conclusion.tex, lines 81–82). The rest of that proof uses this fact. (3) The text never states a consequence for Hartshorne's ample-tangent-bundle conjecture; the link to candidate (D) exists only through the introduction's citation of Mori 1979 and the nef/ample relation.
